column6: Common Warning (read) / WRITE = REMOTE STOP ENGINE
column7: Read: 1 = common warning. FC05 write FF00 = remote stop command.

column6: Common Shutdown (read) / WRITE = REMOTE TEST MODE
column7: Read: 1 = common shutdown alarm. FC05 write FF00 = remote Test command.

column6: Remote Mode (read) / WRITE = REMOTE AUTO MODE
column7: Read: 1 = remote mode. FC05 write FF00 = switch controller to Auto.

column6: Remote Lock (read) / WRITE = REMOTE MANUAL MODE
column7: Read: 1 = remote lock. FC05 write FF00 = switch controller to Manual.
FC05 write FF00: HGM6120 gen close/open key; HGM6110 gen open (drops load).

column7: Read: 1 = mains on load. FC05 FF00: HGM6120 mains close/open; HGM6110 gen close.
